# MLX-Gen

> MLX-Gen is a local MLX image and video generation runtime for Apple Silicon, published as
> `mlx-gen` and exposed through the `mlxgen` CLI and Python helpers.

Use these docs to understand installation, local model setup, generation routing, model
capabilities, MLX-Gen optimized quantized packages, Wan video behavior, and application integration.

Multi-output contract note: CLI batching is seed-driven. `--seed` accepts several explicit seeds,
`--auto-seeds` is available on `mlxgen generate` and `mlxgen upscale`, duplicate explicit seeds are
rejected, underlying model methods remain singular, and unified `mlxgen generate` Python families
also expose `load_generation_model(...).generate_outputs(...)` for serial multi-output reuse.

## Core Docs

- [README.md](README.md): project overview, mflux credit, install commands, published model links, Wan TI2V/A14B notes, and ecosystem links.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): index for the documentation tree.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): first-run workflow for install, download, prepare, image generation, image editing, SeedVR2 image/video restoration and upscaling, and Wan video.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): system overview and model-file lifecycle diagrams, package shape, command boundaries, runtime failure contract, quantization policy, and the Python integration boundary.
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): `mlxgen` command surface, generation routing, public tasks and internal modes, image/video/reference input roles, the `--outpaint-fill`/`--outpaint-fill-color`/`--outpaint-passes` conditioning-canvas options, Bernini R2V/RV2V/V2V options, Wan video controls, SeedVR2 upscaling, runtime events, metadata, the two restoration families and their `restoration` capability rows, and the capability schema (`schema_version` 12, including reference-image bounds, restoration routes, and the outpaint fill and pass contracts).
- [docs/image-edit-modes.md](docs/image-edit-modes.md): plain-language guide to latent img2img, edit-reference, masked edit/inpaint, structured control, multi-reference, generative reframe, and outpaint with its per-side padding and selectable conditioning canvas, including what each mode preserves and what to expect from the output.
- [docs/masked-editing.md](docs/masked-editing.md): canonical masked-edit reference — request contract (white repaints, black preserved, no `--image-strength` with a mask), per-model route matrix with proof grades (Qwen edit/base, Z-Image Turbo, FLUX.2 Klein, video masks; non-turbo Z-Image masked edit is withdrawn for now), per-family behavior including the tunable base-Qwen `--mask-strength` warm start and `effective_steps` metadata, and route selection advice.
- [docs/qwen-route-matrix.md](docs/qwen-route-matrix.md): current MLX-Gen route truth for Qwen Image and Qwen Image Edit, mapping public `mlxgen` capability ids to upstream Diffusers Qwen pipelines and current proof surfaces.
- [docs/qwen-localized-editing.md](docs/qwen-localized-editing.md): plain-language comparison of Qwen masked edit, Qwen structured control, and base-Qwen control-inpaint, including ControlNet/sidecar definitions and links to the accepted proof artifacts.
- [docs/previews.md](docs/previews.md): step-wise generation previews rendered with published tiny autoencoders (`taef1` for the FLUX.1 latent space including Z-Image, `taef2` for the FLUX.2 latent space including ERNIE and Bonsai), reproducible tiny-versus-full command pairs with contact sheets, the `--preview-decoder auto|tiny|full` contract, the explicit per-latent-space availability table, measured fidelity and decode/wall-time costs on M5 Max, the `PreviewDecoder` + `ImageUtil.to_pil_image` application path for realtime preview frames, and the guarantee that final outputs are always full-VAE decoded.
- [docs/upscaling.md](docs/upscaling.md): restoration guide for the two families hosted by `mlxgen upscale`, and how to pick one. SeedVR2 restores images and video and scales: official 3B/7B source usage, published q8/q4 handles, shortest-edge and scale-factor sizing with exact-geometry image restoration (`1x` is pixel-identical), automatic step selection on flat/dark content, the conservative safe-video profile, the `29/8` multi-chunk floor, and the accepted five-second Eiffel proof bundles. SwiftVR restores video only, at the source resolution, bf16 only, with a `4a + 1` clip contract: about 40x SeedVR2 throughput at a fifth of the peak memory, positioned as an offline batch route rather than real-time on Apple Silicon. Includes per-family capability inspection, the three-way comparison bundle, reproduction commands, and timing/memory data.
- [docs/edit-capabilities.md](docs/edit-capabilities.md): image-edit and adjacent structured-control contact sheets, exact model/package statuses, the published outpaint capability fields including `outpaint_preservation` and the per-route validated envelope, and command logs for Qwen Image Edit, Qwen Image Edit 2509/2511, base Qwen structured control, FLUX.2 Klein, latent I2I rows, and the masked-edit 5x5 matrix grading the FLUX.2 Klein, base-Qwen native, and Z-Image non-turbo masked routes. FIBO Edit is unsupported through unified `mlxgen generate`.
- [docs/reframe-outpaint.md](docs/reframe-outpaint.md): `--reframe-padding` and `--outpaint-padding` workflows, per-side padding and how to extend one side, one axis, or all four in a single call, the `--outpaint-fill` conditioning-canvas modes and how `auto` resolves them, padding guidance including the automatic two-pass split of deep two-axis requests (`--outpaint-passes`) with the measured corner-depth sweep, strict FLUX.2 Klein outpaint on distilled 4B/9B (guidance 1.0) and base 4B/9B (guidance 4.0), the cross-route outpaint matrix running every supported route on one source with per-route timings and source drift, the 2026-09-02 axis-coverage sheets (three source aspect ratios x eight padding configurations, in `docs/assets/validation/outpaint-axis-coverage-2026-09-02/`), exact commands, and the three related validation profile ids.
- [docs/lora.md](docs/lora.md): route-specific LoRA capability fields, explicit adapter download, strict scale matching, exact adapter/base-model compatibility, source/no-LoRA/with-LoRA validation, exact public proof rows for current Qwen, Z-Image, FLUX.2, ERNIE, and Wan routes, including base Qwen latent, the exact `AbstractFramework/z-image-turbo-8bit` latent children's-drawing row, Qwen 2511 multi-reference/reframe/outpaint, FLUX.2 Klein 9B multi-reference, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B outpaint, direct `lightx2v/Wan2.2-Lightning` download, and current guidance that MLX-Gen q8 packages are the validated Lightning target rather than arbitrary external FP8 checkpoints.
- [docs/wan-video.md](docs/wan-video.md): practical Wan2.2 T2V/I2V guidance, plain and masked (`--video-mask-path`) prompt-guided A14B video-to-video with the exact reproducible proof commands and included artifacts, the natively ported Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B route (`--reference-image` object injection and learned mask conditioning, parity-proven against diffusers), a measured motion-fidelity ladder (strength vs gesture preservation), the `video_strength` effective-steps contract, output canvas and source mapping (`--canvas-policy`, `--resize-mode`), repeat-run and application performance options (prompt-embed disk cache, resident text encoder, health-check opt-out, opt-in compiled transformer, A14B inactive-expert release), broader A14B target size families, and `101`-frame, 20 fps M5 Max comparison clips for A14B and TI2V-5B.
- [docs/minimax-h3.md](docs/minimax-h3.md): MiniMax-H3 text-to-video and first-frame image-to-video (`--image-path`) with synchronized stereo audio: catalog entries (`minimax-h3`, `minimax-h3-turbo`, `minimax-h3-turbo-544p`), lightx2v Turbo adapters, structured prompt sections (`--prompt`, `--soundscape`, `--music`), `17n+5` frame rule and 32-pixel canvas grid, `--quantize 8` load-time quantization or a prepared 75 GB q8 package (`mlxgen prepare`, `--base-model` schedule selection) with measured M5 Max runtime and memory, motion-prompt guidance for keyframes, the AAC-in-MP4 output and `audio_*` metadata contract, Python usage, verification summary with contact sheets, and current limits (reference-to-video and closing keyframe pending).
- [docs/bernini.md](docs/bernini.md): experimental Bernini-R 1.3B reference-to-video and video-edit routes, pinned BF16 runtime setup and download sizes, the committed official public parity bundle with full prompts and contact sheets per upstream example row, and task-specific recipes for many-reference binding and structure-changing edits.
- [docs/recommendations.md](docs/recommendations.md): conservative model recommendations for `18 GB`, `24 GB`, `32 GB`, `64 GB`, and `128+ GB` Macs based on published MLX-Gen memory measurements.
- [docs/model-management.md](docs/model-management.md): explicit download/prepare commands, local packages, factored Bernini setup and disk preflight, matching Hugging Face handle resolution, and missing-artifact errors.
- [docs/quantization.md](docs/quantization.md): published package matrix, model-specific q8/q4/BF16 policies, Wan storage/runtime behavior, Bernini's BF16-only gate, and Bonsai ternary support.
- [docs/python-integration.md](docs/python-integration.md): embedding MLX-Gen, route-resolved runtimes, Bernini's typed reference list, Wan generation controls, runtime memory defaults, multi-output reuse, `run_outpaint`/`prepare_outpaint`/`prepare_reframe` and the `post_process` save hook, callbacks, and threading guidance.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): common questions about tasks, image-to-image mode selection, SeedVR2 image/video sizing and default audio-preservation behavior, Qwen edit variants, negative prompts, I2I output sizing, `--image-strength`, reframe/outpaint, Wan resolutions and prompting, long image-to-video shot guidance (81-frame budget and continuation routes), model preparation, package naming, and why MLX-Gen q8 Lightning guidance should not be generalized to arbitrary FP8 checkpoints.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms and fixes for missing files, local paths, legacy `mflux-generate-*` migration, I2I sizing, choosing the outpaint conditioning canvas when the padded area continues the border texture, unsupported options, Wan video settings, route-specific LoRA issues, and transfer issues.
